info.name: Waysim — mobile client API
info.description:
Default API: https://api.waysim.co. The baseUrl, locale, appVersion and legalDoc defaults are included as collection variables. For authenticated workflows, select an environment to store tokens and ids. An environment baseUrl overrides the collection default.

Everything the Flutter app calls (`/v1/*`). Import this collection together with `waysim-local.postman_environment.json`, select the environment and run the folders top to bottom: device → sign in → profile → catalog → order → eSIM → wallet → referral → support.

Tokens and ids are saved into the environment automatically (device token, access/refresh tokens, user id, package, order, eSIM, payment, chat cursor). Requests send `Accept-Language`, `X-App-Version` and, for money-moving POSTs, a fresh `Idempotency-Key`. Authorization is `Bearer <accessToken>` when signed in, else `Bearer <deviceToken>`.

Reference: `backend/docs/client-api.md` (conventions, lifecycles, errors) and Swagger at `{{baseUrl}}/docs`. Regenerate after API changes with `pnpm postman:export`.

item.name: 5 · Wallet & crypto top-up (NOWPayments)
item.description: Crypto is the only top-up method. 1) `GET /v1/payments/crypto/currencies` → the coin picker (each coin has its own `minCents`). 2) `POST /v1/payments` with `provider: "crypto"` and `payCurrency` → show `crypto.payAddress`, `crypto.payAmount` (fees included — the customer pays them), the QR of `crypto.qrValue`, `crypto.payExtraId` (memo) when present, and a countdown to `expiresAt` (5–10 min, set by NOWPayments). 3) Poll `GET /v1/payments/:id` every 5–10 s until `credited`, `expired` or a `review_*` status. Every top-up is real: to finish one, send `crypto.payAmount` of the coin to `crypto.payAddress` before `expiresAt`, then re-run "Top-up status".
